paragraphs: Colorado Time Systems makes timing and scoring equipment for aquatic sports, with a broad offering of timing systems for those events. The buyers are aquatic and sporting facilities. The company also publishes planning resources for architects, designers, aquatic consultants and facility owners.

Touchpads are described as lightweight, dependable and internally sealed, detecting even the lightest touch. Start systems include an entry-level model for swimming. Deck plates carry the plug-in connections for touchpads and backup pushbuttons. Scoreboards come as permanent, portable or wireless options, including shot clocks and horns. Multisport scoreboards sit in a powder-coated 5052-alloy aluminum chassis. The diving line is stated to comply with NFHS, NCAA, USA Diving and FINA rules.

The company says it has designed and delivered equipment for over 50 years. It states that it is the Official Scoring and Timing System of USA Water Polo. It also names itself the Official Scoring Partner of USA Diving.

quote.text: We understand that 1/100th of a second matters.
